title: Completed node: restart without another write.

steps.label: Start the graph and save one draft

verification.summary: A separate read-only process found exactly one matching draft after the first process completed. This checks the saved draft, not graph completion.

steps.label: Restart the process and resume the same graph thread

verification.summary: Independent readback: 1 matching draft; 1 node attempt. Expected one draft for this logical operation. The completed node was not executed again on this latest-thread resume.
